bead.title: opencode: add discovery-cache model/reasoning resolution + resolution progress events
bead.description:
PROBLEM: internal/harnesses/opencode/runner.go:184-191 passes req.Model and AdapterReasoningValue(req) straight to -m/--variant with no discovery-cache resolution and emits no resolution events. codex resolves via ResolveRunnerModelWithCache/ResolveRunnerReasoningWithCache and emits RunnerDefaultResolutionEvent/RunnerReasoningResolutionEvent (codex/runner.go:199-200,261-279), so operators see what model/reasoning was actually chosen. opencode --variant values are MODEL-SPECIFIC (not the fixed minimal/low/medium/high/max list hardcoded at runner.go:55), so blind pass-through can send an unsupported variant.

ROOT CAUSE: runner.go:184-191 (no resolution) and missing DiscoveryCache field on the opencode Runner (codex has it, codex/runner.go:45).

PROPOSED FIX: Add DiscoveryCache *harnesses.ModelDiscoveryCache to opencode Runner. In runStreaming, resolve model via harnesses.ResolveRunnerModelWithCache(r.DiscoveryCache, "opencode", modelcatalog.SurfaceEmbeddedOpenAI, req.Model, "opencode/gpt-5.4") and reasoning via ResolveRunnerReasoningWithCache(..., "opencode", req.Reasoning); emit the two resolution events guarded by ShouldEmitRunnerDefaultResolution/ShouldEmitRunnerReasoningResolution exactly as codex/runner.go:261-279. Use resolved values for -m/--variant. SCOPE DECISION (operator): best-effort pass-through of the resolved variant (emit a warning resolution event on unknown variant) — do NOT hard-reject unsupported variants in this bead; strict per-model variant rejection (wiring model_discovery.go:323 sortedOpenCodeVariantNames) is a deliberate follow-up if requested.

NON-SCOPE: hard variant rejection; parser/usage changes.
bead.acceptance:
1. New Test TestRunner_EmitsModelResolutionEvent (fake binary): a routing/resolution progress event is emitted when the default model is resolved (mirror the codex assertion style).
2. New Test TestRunner_ReasoningResolutionForwarded: the resolved reasoning value reaches the --variant arg.
3. opencode Runner exposes a settable DiscoveryCache so tests can inject a fixture snapshot.
4. cd /Users/erik/Projects/fizeau && GOPRIVATE=github.com/easel/* GOSUMDB=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod go test ./internal/harnesses/opencode/... -count=1 -timeout 120s green. Do NOT run `go test ./...` (HANGS).
5. lefthook run pre-commit passes.
